data.fund_type: An open-ended equity scheme investing across large cap, mid cap, small cap stocks
data.investment_objective: The Fund seeks to generate long-term capital appreciation by investing in a diversified portfolio of equity & equity-related instruments across large cap, mid cap and small cap stocks. However, there is no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be realized and the Scheme does not assure or guarantee any returns.
data.asset_allocation: 1. Equity & Equity related instruments out of which - 75% to 100% - Large Cap companies - 25% to 50% - Mid Cap companies - 25% to 50% - Small Cap companies -  25% to 50% 2. Debt and money market instruments - 0% to 25% 3. Units issued by REITs and InvITs - 0% to 10%
data.exit_load: If the units are redeemed / switched out on or before 90 days from the date of allotment – 1% If the units are redeemed / switched out after 90 days from the date of allotment – Nil
